zh: 先确认今天讨论发布计划、预算和风险。
发布目标仍是月底，负责人会在周五给出候选版本。
预算方面，托管费用本季度增加了百分之八。
设计同意削减非必要的动效，但保留无障碍检查。
因此预算决策是先控制托管成本，再评估动效工作。
主要风险是迁移窗口太短，回滚演练还没有完成。
回到发布计划，候选版本必须通过周四的冒烟测试。
最终行动项是工程负责人周三提交回滚清单。
en: We will cover the release plan, budget, and delivery risks.
The release target remains month end, with a candidate due Friday.
Hosting cost is eight percent above this quarter's budget.
Design can remove optional motion while retaining accessibility checks.
The budget decision is to reduce hosting cost before revisiting motion work.
The main risk is a short migration window and an incomplete rollback rehearsal.
Returning to release planning, the candidate must pass Thursday's smoke test.
The engineering lead owns the rollback checklist due Wednesday.
mixed: 今天的 agenda 是 release plan、预算和 delivery risk。
Release target 仍是月底，candidate build 周五交付。
Hosting cost 比本季度 budget 高百分之八。
Design 同意去掉 optional motion，但保留 accessibility checks。
预算 decision 是先降 hosting cost，再评估动效工作。
主要 risk 是 migration window 太短，rollback rehearsal 未完成。
回到 release plan，candidate 必须通过周四 smoke test。
Engineering lead 周三前提交 rollback checklist。

zh: 访谈将讨论个人背景、系统设计和协作经历。
候选人过去三年负责离线同步和冲突解决。
系统设计题需要在弱网络下同步大量本地笔记。
候选人建议使用版本向量，并明确说明冲突不能静默覆盖。
权衡结论是优先保证可恢复性，接受稍高的元数据开销。
协作案例中，需求分歧通过书面决策记录解决。
回到个人背景，候选人曾主导一次存储格式迁移。
观察员记录的待核实项是迁移后的故障率数据。
en: The interview covers background, system design, and collaboration.
The candidate owned offline sync and conflict handling for three years.
The design exercise is to synchronize local notes over unreliable networks.
The candidate proposes version vectors and rejects silent conflict overwrites.
The tradeoff favors recoverability despite modest metadata overhead.
A collaboration dispute was resolved through a written decision record.
Returning to background, the candidate led a storage format migration.
The observer flags post-migration failure rates for verification.
mixed: 本次 interview 覆盖 background、system design 和 collaboration。
候选人三年负责 offline sync 与 conflict handling。
Design exercise 是在弱网络下同步 local notes。
候选人建议 version vector，并拒绝 silent overwrite。
Tradeoff 是优先 recoverability，接受 metadata overhead。
一次 collaboration dispute 通过 decision record 解决。
回到 background，候选人主导过 storage migration。
Observer 标记 migration 后 failure rate 需要核实。

zh: 早晨通勤时记录今天要处理站会、编码和采购。
站会确认搜索故障已缓解，但监控告警仍需调整。
编码时先复现了缓存键碰撞，再补充回归测试。
同事建议保留旧索引一天，以便发生问题时回滚。
最终实现同时写入新旧索引，并记录清理日期。
傍晚采购了电池和网线，没有购买计划外设备。
睡前回看站会事项，监控阈值尚未由值班人员确认。
明早第一件事是跟进告警阈值，而不是删除旧索引。
en: During the commute I noted standup, coding, and shopping tasks.
Standup confirmed the search incident is mitigated, but alert tuning remains.
Coding began by reproducing a cache-key collision and adding a regression test.
A colleague suggested retaining the old index for one day as rollback cover.
The implementation dual-writes indexes and records the cleanup date.
In the evening I bought batteries and a network cable, with no extra devices.
Reviewing standup later, the on-call engineer has not confirmed the threshold.
Tomorrow starts with the alert threshold, not deletion of the old index.
mixed: 通勤时记下 standup、coding 和 shopping 三类事项。
Standup 确认 search incident 已缓解，但 alert tuning 未完成。
Coding 先复现 cache-key collision，再增加 regression test。
同事建议 old index 保留一天作为 rollback cover。
实现采用 dual-write，并明确 cleanup date。
傍晚买了 batteries 和 network cable，没有额外设备。
回看 standup，on-call 尚未确认 alert threshold。
明早先跟进 alert threshold，不删除 old index。

zh: 大家先聊周末旅行、最近读的书和晚餐安排。
旅行计划是周六坐早班车去海边，遇雨则改去博物馆。
最近读的书讨论了城市如何为步行者设计街道。
另一位说书中的公交案例比道路案例更有说服力。
两人约好交换书单，但没有承诺具体日期。
晚餐决定选择车站附近的面馆，并提前确认素食选项。
话题回到旅行，需要有人在周四查看天气预报。
最终由小林查看天气，其他人不需要购买车票。
en: The conversation starts with weekend travel, recent books, and dinner.
The travel plan is an early train to the coast, with a museum if it rains.
A recent book explains how cities can design streets for pedestrians.
Another reader found its public-transit example more convincing than roads.
They agree to exchange reading lists without setting a date.
Dinner will be at the noodle shop near the station after checking vegan options.
Returning to travel, someone needs to check Thursday's forecast.
Lin will check the weather; no one else needs to buy tickets.
mixed: 大家先聊 weekend travel、recent books 和 dinner。
Travel plan 是早班车去海边，下雨则去 museum。
最近的 book 讨论 pedestrian-friendly street design。
另一位认为 public-transit example 比道路案例更有说服力。
两人决定 exchange reading lists，但没有 date。
Dinner 选车站旁 noodle shop，并确认 vegan options。
回到 travel，需要有人周四 check forecast。
Lin 负责 weather check，其他人不需要 buy tickets。
